items.exampleEn: The school sports day will take place next Friday.
items.exampleZh: 學校運動會將在下星期五舉行。

items.exampleEn: We took turns driving on the long trip.
items.exampleZh: 長途旅行時我們輪流開車。

items.exampleEn: My dad takes notes when he reads the news.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸看新聞時會做筆記。

items.exampleEn: More than fifty students took part in the race.
items.exampleZh: 有超過五十個學生參加了這場賽跑。

items.exampleEn: Please tell me the truth about the broken window.
items.exampleZh: 請跟我說實話，窗戶是怎麼破的。

items.exampleEn: Pinocchio's nose grows when he tells a lie.
items.exampleZh: 小木偶說謊的時候鼻子會變長。

items.exampleEn: We wasted time waiting for a bus that never came.
items.exampleZh: 我們白白浪費時間等一班一直沒來的公車。

items.sentenceEn: Let's take turns washing the dishes after dinner.
items.sentenceZh: 我們晚餐後輪流洗碗吧。

items.audioEn: The concert will take place in the park if it doesn't rain.
items.audioZh: 如果不下雨，演唱會將在公園舉行。
items.questionZh: 演唱會在什麼情況下會在公園舉行？
options: If the park is not too crowded

items.sentenceEn: I'm sorry. I should have told the truth.
items.sentenceZh: 對不起，我應該說實話的。

items.sentenceEn: Stop wasting time and start your homework.
items.sentenceZh: 別再浪費時間了，開始寫功課吧。

items.stemEn: Twenty teams will ____ the singing contest next month.
items.stemZh: 下個月將有二十個隊伍參加歌唱比賽。

items.stemEn: Kevin said he was sick, but he was at the movies. He ____.
items.stemZh: Kevin 說他生病了，但他其實在看電影。他說謊。

items.passageEn: Last month, our school's science fair took place in the gym. Every class had to take part in it. Our group figured out how to make a small car run on sunlight. We took turns giving the talk, and Jenny took notes on every question from the judges. One boy in another group told a lie: he said he made his robot by himself, but his brother did it. When the teacher asked again, he finally told the truth. We didn't win, but nobody felt we wasted time.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們學校的科展在體育館舉行。每一班都得參加。我們這組想出了怎麼讓一台小車靠陽光跑。我們輪流上台講解，Jenny 則把評審問的每個問題都記下來。另一組有個男生說謊：他說機器人是他自己做的，但其實是他的兄弟做的。老師再問一次時，他終於說了實話。我們沒有得獎，但沒有人覺得是在浪費時間。

questions.questionZh: Jenny 在科展中做了什麼？
options: 幫他的兄弟完成了作品

questions.questionZh: 另一組的男生說了什麼謊？

items.promptZh: 上課時我都用電腦做筆記。
referenceEn: I take notes on my computer in class.
In class, I always take notes on my computer.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 take notes 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 make notes、write notes 等）也算對
平常的習慣用現在簡單式（例如 take notes、always take notes、usually make notes 等）
「用電腦」可寫，例如 on my computer、with my computer 等

referenceEn: She told me the truth yesterday.
Yesterday she told me the truth.
She told the truth to me yesterday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 told me the truth、told the truth to me 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 was honest with me 等）也算對
昨天的事用過去式（例如 told、was 等）
